notes.title: A Bonus Stage Update
notes.content:
Thank you for your great love.
A bonus stage has been added.
We recommend you to play this after watching the ending of the main game.
You can go directly to the bonus stage by clicking the "Bonus Stage" button on the main screen.

Thank you!

notes.title: Update Notes For Oct 29
notes.content: Hard mode added to the game (difficulty can be selected in Main Menu > Options).

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue where the game wouldn't restart for a long time at the "Game" level intermittently.

Thank you for your interest and feedback on our game.

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
The bugs that have been fixed so far are:
[list]
[*] Addressed issue where the game experience could be different depending on the user environment (frame rate).
[*] Fixed an issue where the W, A, S, D keys did not work properly in some stages.
[/list]

We apologize for the inconvenience caused to your play.
